title: Recursion: Turning Repeated Work into a Smaller Problem
utility_use_case: A research team receives a CSV of paired instrument readings and wants a quick visual audit before selecting a statistical model. Run the scatter command to inspect association, spread, and possible data-entry anomalies, then use the JSON counts to report how many rows were omitted for missing or nonfinite selected values. The plot is exploratory and descriptive; it does not establish significance or causation.
